preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'bw' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s contains only lowercase English letters 'b' and 'w'.

postconditions.expression: output == max(zebra_length(s, i, i + l) for i in range(len(s)) for l in range(1, len(s) - i + 1))
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum possible length of the zebra that Grisha can produce by performing the given operations.
